# Preserved upstream automation

These unchanged workflow definitions belong to OpenAdapt's release, scientific
benchmark and hosted-service lifecycle. They are retained for provenance but are
not scheduled in this downstream repository. L1ght5p33d runs its own Windows
and Linux tests, package inspection, license, vulnerability and secret scans in
`../workflows/l1ght5p33d-ci.yml`. Upstream tests/source are retained unchanged;
this preview does not claim to qualify every inherited target or hosted service.
